figs.name: parts-of-a-control-valve-signal-flowchart
figs.alt: control valve signal flowchart from controller and positioner to actuator and trim
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a control valve works in a loop: controller signal, positioner, actuator, trim and process with transmitter feedback.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Control valve signal flow from controller to process flow</title>
<rect width="800" height="500" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#155e75" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How the Parts Work Together</text>
<rect x="30" y="90" width="132" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="96.0" y="127.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Controller</text>
<text x="96.0" y="150.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">4 to 20 mA</text>
<text x="96.0" y="173.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">command</text>
<line x1="164" y1="145" x2="184" y2="145" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="182" y="90" width="132" height="110" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="248.0" y="127.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Positioner</text>
<text x="248.0" y="150.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">compares</text>
<text x="248.0" y="173.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">with stem</text>
<line x1="316" y1="145" x2="336" y2="145" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="334" y="90" width="132" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="127.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Actuator</text>
<text x="400.0" y="150.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">air moves</text>
<text x="400.0" y="173.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the stem</text>
<line x1="468" y1="145" x2="488" y2="145" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="486" y="90" width="132" height="110" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="552.0" y="127.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Trim</text>
<text x="552.0" y="150.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">plug sets</text>
<text x="552.0" y="173.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">flow area</text>
<line x1="620" y1="145" x2="640" y2="145" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="638" y="90" width="132" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="704.0" y="127.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Process</text>
<text x="704.0" y="150.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">flow, level</text>
<text x="704.0" y="173.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">or pressure</text>
<polyline points="706,202 706,300 96,300 96,204" fill="none" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)" stroke-dasharray="7 5"/>
<rect x="250" y="270" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="294.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Transmitter feedback</text>
<text x="400.0" y="317.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">measured value to controller</text>
<text x="400" y="380" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Closed loop: the controller compares the measured value with the setpoint</text>
<text x="400" y="410" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and changes the 4 to 20 mA signal until the error is zero.</text>
<text x="400" y="455" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Accessories such as limit switches and a solenoid valve sit on the actuator.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: parts-of-a-control-valve-flow-control-methods-infographic
figs.alt: four methods of flow control in valves with globe, gate, butterfly and diaphragm examples
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing the four ways valves control flow: plug against an orifice, sliding, rotating and flexible element designs with valve examples.
figs.after_h2: Methods of Flow Control in Valves
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 470" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Four methods of flow control in valves</title>
<rect width="800" height="470" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#155e75" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4 Ways a Valve Controls Flow</text>
<rect x="30" y="70" width="360" height="170" rx="14" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="70" cy="110" r="22" fill="#0e7490"/>
<text x="70" y="117" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="105" y="117" font-size="21" fill="#155e75" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Plug against orifice</text>
<text x="60" y="162" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Plug moves to or from seat</text>
<text x="60" y="190" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Globe and needle valves</text>
<text x="60" y="218" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Best for throttling</text>
<rect x="410" y="70" width="360" height="170" rx="14" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="450" cy="110" r="22" fill="#0e7490"/>
<text x="450" y="117" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="485" y="117" font-size="21" fill="#155e75" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Sliding element</text>
<text x="440" y="162" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Gate or plug slides across</text>
<text x="440" y="190" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Gate and plug valves</text>
<text x="440" y="218" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Mostly on and off</text>
<rect x="30" y="260" width="360" height="170" rx="14" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="70" cy="300" r="22" fill="#0e7490"/>
<text x="70" y="307" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="105" y="307" font-size="21" fill="#155e75" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Rotating element</text>
<text x="60" y="352" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Disc or ball turns 90°</text>
<text x="60" y="380" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Butterfly and ball valves</text>
<text x="60" y="408" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Quarter turn, compact</text>
<rect x="410" y="260" width="360" height="170" rx="14" fill="#ecfeff" stroke="#0e7490" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="450" cy="300" r="22" fill="#0e7490"/>
<text x="450" y="307" font-size="20" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="485" y="307" font-size="21" fill="#155e75" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Flexible material</text>
<text x="440" y="352" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Membrane pinches flow</text>
<text x="440" y="380" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Diaphragm and pinch valves</text>
<text x="440" y="408" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Slurry and corrosive fluid</text>
<text x="400" y="455" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Control valves mostly use methods 1 and 3 because they throttle smoothly.</text>
</svg>
